_about: Tabletop mode: every character's numbers in whole counters (max 20 each of HP, mana and ward). Names, colours and forbidden elements come from characters.json unless set here. Each spell's 'text' is its card text: keep it in step with the numbers. Rules: docs/tabletop-rules.md. Engine and simulator: js/tabletop.js.

spells.name: Shield
spells.text: Arcane ward of 14, for a Normal flick (a Greater ward is 12 and needs 3 winks).

spells.name: Counter
spells.text: Until dispelled: anyone who strikes you takes 3, and your ward doesn't wear down.

spells.name: Ward
spells.text: Until dispelled: curses can't touch you. A dispel at you only removes this Ward.

spells.name: Empower
spells.text: Your next strike deals double damage.

spells.name: Blood Pact
spells.text: Turn 3 HP winks into mana winks before you flick, and pot with them. If it is cast, gain 4 more mana.

spells.name: Drain
spells.text: Dark strike of 5. Heal half the HP damage it deals (round down).

spells.name: Regen
spells.text: Until dispelled: heal 1 at every round end.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.text: Roll a die: on 4+ the foe can't pick Damage next round.

spells.name: Vine Whip
spells.text: Physical strike of 3. Until cleansed, vines deal 1 to the foe at every round end.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.text: The next strike at you does nothing.

spells.name: Time Drain
spells.text: Until cleansed: the foe gains 1 less mana each round (and from Meditate).

spells.name: Rewind
spells.text: Arcane ward of 7, and heal the HP you lost last round (max 5).

spells.name: War Paint
spells.text: Until dispelled: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1).

spells.name: Savage Charge
spells.text: Physical strike of 5. The foe loses 2 mana.

spells.name: Frenzy
spells.text: Until dispelled: your strikes deal +2, but each costs you 1 HP.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.text: Fire strike of 4 (a Lesser strike is 2).

spells.name: Flame Shield
spells.text: Fire ward of 8. While it holds, anyone who strikes you takes 2.

spells.name: Candle
spells.text: Until cleansed: the foe takes 2 each time they cast Protection or Meditate.

spells.name: Ice Lance
spells.text: Ice strike of 5. If it reaches HP, the foe can't pick Damage next round.

spells.name: Frost Armor
spells.text: Until dispelled: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1), and strikers take 1.

spells.name: Blizzard
spells.text: Until cleansed: at every round end the foe takes 1 and loses 1 mana.

spells.name: Galvanize
spells.text: Your next Lightning strike deals +4.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.text: Lightning strike of 4. Roll a die: on 3+ it arcs for 2 more.

spells.name: Conductivity
spells.text: Until cleansed: every strike on the foe deals +1.

spells.name: Heal
spells.text: Heal 6.

spells.name: Purge
spells.text: Remove all your curses and heal 3.

spells.name: Radiant
spells.text: Arcane strike of 3. The foe loses 2 mana.

spells.name: Agony
spells.text: Until cleansed: the foe takes 2 at every round end, unless they Meditated that round (Corruption stops Meditate escaping it).

spells.name: Silence
spells.text: Until cleansed: each spell the foe casts, they roll a die: on 1–2 it fails (no mana spent).

spells.name: Corruption
spells.text: Until cleansed: the foe gains 1 less mana each round (and from Meditate), and Meditate doesn't escape Agony.

spells.name: Vanish
spells.text: The next strike at you misses.

spells.name: Mana Siphon
spells.text: Quick: before anyone pays, steal 4 mana from the foe.

spells.name: Blink
spells.text: Until dispelled: roll a die for each strike at you, on 4+ it misses. Plus a Lightning ward of 3.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.text: Physical ward of 9.

spells.name: Stonesoul
spells.text: Until dispelled: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1).

spells.name: Rockfall
spells.text: Physical strike of 7.

spells.name: Conjure Blade
spells.text: Conjure a blade (max 3). Until dispelled, each blade deals 1 to the foe at every round end.

spells.name: Bladestorm
spells.text: Needs a blade. Launch all your blades: a Physical strike of 3 per blade. The blades are used up.

spells.name: Iron Patience
spells.text: Until dispelled: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1).

spells.name: Plague
spells.text: Until cleansed: the foe takes 1 at every round end.

spells.name: Maggot Cloud
spells.text: The foe loses 3 mana now. Until cleansed, they gain 1 less mana each round (and from Meditate).

spells.name: Bone Totem
spells.text: Until dispelled: heal 1 at every round end.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.text: Raise 3 skeletons (max 5 on the table). Each has 1 HP and stands in front of your ward: every point of damage (strikes and ticks) kills one skeleton before anything reaches your ward. Dispels can't touch them. Each skeleton still standing deals 1 to the foe at every round end.

spells.name: Necrotic Drain
spells.text: Dark strike of 4. Heal half the HP damage it deals (round down).

spells.name: Soul Tithe
spells.text: Until cleansed: the foe loses 1 mana for each of your skeletons they kill.

spells.name: Simulacrum
spells.text: Summon a simulacrum (max 2). Until dispelled, each deals 1 to the foe at every round end.

spells.name: Bewitch
spells.text: The foe's next strike hits themselves instead.

spells.name: Feint
spells.text: Arcane strike of 4. The foe loses 2 mana.

spells.name: Enthral
spells.text: Secretly write down Damage, Protection or Dispel. If the foe's next pick is that, it's lost and you take up to 3 of the mana they paid.

spells.name: Arcane Weave
spells.text: Your next strike deals +3 and makes the foe lose 2 mana. Plus an Arcane ward of 4.

spells.name: Spellbind
spells.text: Until cleansed: the foe's most-cast category (Damage, Protection or Dispel) costs 3 more.

spells.name: Dragon Scales
spells.text: Until dispelled: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1), and strikers take 1.

spells.name: Wyrmfire Breath
spells.text: Fire strike of 4. Until cleansed, the foe burns for 1 at every round end.

spells.name: Ancient Wrath
spells.text: Physical strike of 9. Once per game.

spells.name: Caustic Bomb
spells.text: Dark strike of 3. Until cleansed, poison deals 1 to the foe at every round end. If the strike reached HP, the poison ignores wards.

spells.name: Volatile Tonic
spells.text: Roll a die: on 1–3 heal 6; on 4–6 your next strike deals +3.

spells.name: Unstable Concoction
spells.text: Arcane strike: roll a die and deal that much. On a 6, roll again and add it (keep going on 6s).

spells.name: Singularity
spells.text: Until cleansed: a rift deals 2 to the foe at every round end.

spells.name: Gravity Well
spells.text: Dark strike of a third of the foe's HP (round down, min 3).

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.text: Arcane strike of half the foe's HP (round down, min 4). You take 2.

spells.name: Raise Graveguard
spells.text: Raise 1 graveguard (max 3 on the table). Each has 3 HP and stands in front of your ward: damage (strikes and ticks) wears down the oldest graveguard first, and only what gets past them reaches your ward. Dispels can't touch them. Each graveguard still standing deals 1 to the foe at every round end.

spells.name: Vanhal's Danse Macabre
spells.text: Needs a graveguard on the table. Until dispelled: each of your graveguard deals 1 more at every round end.

spells.name: Curse of the Years
spells.text: Until cleansed: the foe takes 2 at every round end, whatever they did. Unlike Agony, Meditating doesn't escape it.

spells.name: Doom Bolt
spells.text: Dark strike of 3. Blast: 1 of it goes around a ward straight to HP.

spells.name: Infernal Gate
spells.text: The next strike at you misses, and you step through the Gate. Next round you skip your spell and can't be touched: nothing can be aimed at you and nothing ticks on you. At that round's end, trade places at the table and cast Blue Fire free (no mana, no flick).

spells.name: Blue Fire
spells.text: Fire strike of 7. Big blast: 3 of it goes around a ward straight to HP.
